title: Harness entry
description: One place people run agents, plugins and skills, named by its own name: a harness (the program that thinks when work arrives, such as opencode or Claude Code), a personal assistant that takes open pieces (Agent Skills, MCP connectors), or a cloud runtime that hosts an agent's own code. What it supports, capability by capability, with the vendor documentation each claim comes from. One file per harness in data/agent-platforms/harnesses/. tools/ci/check-agent-platforms.mjs validates every file against this schema.

id.description: Lower-case id, the same as the file name without .json. For a harness AgentMesh also runs trials under, the same name as its entry in the adlc repository's agents/image/bases/tenant-harnesses.json.

name.description: The harness as its maker names it, for example 'Claude Code' or 'opencode'.

vendor.description: The company or project that makes it.

kind.description: harness: a program that runs an agent's skills, tools and plugins (opencode, the Claude Agent SDK, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). assistant: a personal assistant a person uses directly that accepts open pieces such as Agent Skills or MCP connectors (the Claude apps, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini). cloud-runtime: a hosted service that runs an agent's own code as a service.

summary.description: One neutral sentence on what it is.

platform.description: The id of the entry in platforms/ that this harness belongs to, when there is one (for example the Claude Agent SDK belongs to anthropic).

house_stack.description: True for the harness AgentMesh's House Stack runs agents in. Only one entry may say so.

plugin_formats.description: The plugin formats it installs, in the names Inspect gives a plugin's tools: 'Agent Plugins 1.0.0', 'Claude Code', 'Cursor', 'Codex' and the like. Empty when it installs none.

documentation.description: URL prefixes where the maker's own documentation lives. Every source URL in this file starts with one of them.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: It loads skills in the Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md).

mcp.title: Tool servers (MCP)
mcp.description: It connects the agent to MCP servers: remote servers over HTTP, local programs over stdio, or both; what says which.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: It installs a plugin, a package of skills, tool servers and the rest: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 or its own format; what says which.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: It runs programs a plugin or the agent declares on events (a session starting, before a tool call).

a2a.title: Agent-to-agent (A2A)
a2a.description: It calls agents elsewhere, or serves the agent to them, over the Agent2Agent protocol.

scheduled-work.title: Scheduled work
scheduled-work.description: It runs the agent's work on a timetable without a person starting it.

sandboxes.title: Sandboxes
sandboxes.description: It runs code the agent writes in an isolated environment it provides.

support.description: yes: the documentation says it does. partial: only part of it (what says which part), or only in preview or beta. no: the documentation says it does not. unknown: not found in the documentation on the date checked, never a guess.

what.description: One short factual sentence, as the maker names the feature, saying preview or beta where the maker does.

sources.description: The maker's own documentation pages the claim comes from, each one opened on the date checked.
